sectors.name: Technology
themes: Global AI capex and semiconductor upcycle are lifting Indonesian-listed tech proxies, with SK Hynix and Samsung surging on HBM demand, creating a spillover effect into local sentiment.
Indonesia's accelerating digital economy, driven by e-commerce and fintech adoption, is a structural tailwind for local tech platforms, independent of US rate cycles.
The rupiah's stability and improving domestic liquidity are enabling foreign inflows into IDX tech, amplifying beta to global tech rallies.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's tech rally is broad-based, led by global semiconductor and e-commerce names, signaling risk-on appetite. Overweight IDX tech, favoring liquid large-caps with local revenue exposure, as US AI-driven demand and domestic digital adoption converge. Trim on any sharp reversal in US semis; rotate into Indonesian platform stocks if the rupiah stabilizes.
